g.text: Wave-pinning · d₀ = 11 · full support 3 · coefficient peak 0.1 · held cue T = 1000 · native kinetics and exact basals retained

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Every saved native cue-on frame is shown. Dashed: initial 10%-contrast edges. White/orange: cue centre/support. Grey padding is outside the shorter domain.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Time is linear to 0.1 then log. Complex axes have equal scale; dashed circle is R = 1; squares mark withdrawal and numbers give actual native times.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Physical cue arc is matched; native target angle and incumbent architecture differ. These are activity patterns and resultants, not site ancestry or cell movement.
